data.name: Concentrate Poison
data.description: The underground chemist can combine two doses of the same poison to increase their effects. This requires two doses of the poison and 1 minute of concentration. When completed, the underground chemist has one dose of poison. The poison's frequency is extended by 50%% and the save DC increases by +2. This poison must be used within 1 hour of its creation or it is ruined.
